## 2025-01-28 - Fast in-memory parsing of IFC files with ifcopenshell
**Learning:** `ifcopenshell` allows for parsing IFC files directly from string memory using `ifcopenshell.file.from_string()` rather than requiring writing a temporary file to disk and parsing via `ifcopenshell.open()`.
**Action:** When working with uploaded or dynamically generated byte contents of IFC files, decode them to string (e.g. `utf-8`) and load them directly into memory instead of doing intermediate disk I/O. This yields a significant performance boost (measured at ~4x for small files) and reduces filesystem clutter.
